skirmish.module.hunt.name: Treasure Hunt
skirmish.module.hunt.description: When the server says where something was placed but hides digits («… Золотой Спавнер на координатах 1*4*, 5, 1*9*»), a hunt starts: the mask with its hidden digits, the nearest cell you have not been in with an arrow and distance, how many cells you have been through, and how far to dig in a candidate cell. A waypoint follows the nearest cell; the map shades visited cells. Only the chat line and your own position are used.
skirmish.module.hunt.setting.card.toolti: The hunt card on the HUD (left column)
skirmish.module.hunt.setting.waypoint.to: A «Hunt: …» waypoint moves to the nearest cell you have not been in
skirmish.module.hunt.setting.sound.toolt: A short sound when a hunt starts
skirmish.module.hunt.setting.stop_key.to: Ends the hunt and removes its waypoint (also /skirmish hunt stop)
skirmish.hunt.all_visited: You have been in every cell
skirmish.hunt.in_cell: You are in a candidate cell
skirmish.hunt.other_dim: The hunt is in another dimension
